headline: Elon Musk says he probably won’t be playing GTA 6.
body: Elon Musk says he probably won’t be playing GTA 6. “I don’t think I’ll be playing GTA 6,” Musk said, explaining that he only played a small amount of GTA 5 before stopping. According to Musk, the opening section required him to shoot police officers in order to progress, which he said he “just couldn’t do.”
